name: Triped
description: A three-wheeled cycle, with or without pedals, whose electric motor is rated between 751 and 2,000 watts, so a three-wheeled e-bike or e-trike with a motor over the 750-watt e-bike limit lands here. Defined by Delaware Code Title 21 §101(88) and regulated alongside mopeds by §4198M, as amended by House Substitute 1 for HB 439 (effective September 24, 2026).

restrictions.rule: Three wheels, either of them at least 10 inches in diameter; pedals are optional
Its electric motor is rated between 751 and 2,000 watts; an electric bicycle is never a triped
Riders need a driver's license, carried while riding, but no motorcycle endorsement; a nonresident needs a valid license from their home state
Riders and passengers under 18 must wear a fastened helmet meeting the bicycle helmet standard
Registered with the DMV for $5 per three years, with a decal or number plate
Barred from interstate and limited-access highways, even to cross them, and from railroad rights-of-way except to cross
Barred from bike lanes, sidewalks and any pathway closed to motor vehicle traffic
Bicycle traffic rules apply to it on public roads
